## Installers

Download the one for your PC:

- `ScanManager-{version}-x64-setup.exe`: most Windows PCs (Intel/AMD)
- `ScanManager-{version}-arm64-setup.exe`: Windows on ARM (Snapdragon and similar)

Everything the app needs is included; there's no separate .NET install. It installs for the current user without an admin prompt. Choose "Install for all users" on the first page to install system-wide. To upgrade, run a newer installer.

The installers aren't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first run: choose **More info → Run anyway**. <!-- unsigned only -->
